_comment: Maps prayer IDs to their line ranges in content/feigenbaum/feigenbaum-siddur-extracted.txt. Editorial work — extracted line ranges must be verified against the PDF before extraction is run. Add entries here as content production progresses.

modeh_ani.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Hashkamas Ha'boker, Modeh Ani
modeh_ani.notes: Sefaria groups Modeh Ani + Reishis Chochmah under prayer id modeh_ani; Torah Tzivah belongs to birchot_hatorah. Line 623 (combined title) is excluded so Torah Tzivah's title doesn't inflate coverage. Range 624-668 covers Modeh Ani body + Reishis Chochmah body + Baruch Shem K'vod.

netilat_yadayim.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Hashkamas Ha'boker, Netilas Yadayim
netilat_yadayim.notes: Feigenbaum bundles Netilas Yadayim + Asher Yatzar under 'My Body Works!'. Split at line 727 where the second 'Baruch Atah Adonai' starts the Asher Yatzar commentary. NY range 713-726 covers the netilat-yadayim bracha lemma walk-through.

asher_yatzar.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Hashkamas Ha'boker, Asher Yatzar
asher_yatzar.notes: Asher Yatzar commentary starts at line 727 (second 'Baruch Atah Adonai'). Walks through asher yatzar's body description (nekavim, chalulim) and the closing rofei kol basar u'mafli la'asot. Lines 750-762 are the Hebrew bracha block (no English here).

elokai_neshama.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Hashkamas Ha'boker, Elokai Neshama
elokai_neshama.notes: Feigenbaum's 'And I Have a Soul!' section. Hebrew title at line 766. Trimmed to 817 to exclude the next section's 'I Have a Torah!' heading at line 818.

birchot_hatorah.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Hashkamas Ha'boker, Birchos HaTorah
birchot_hatorah.notes: Feigenbaum's 'I Have a Torah!' section + Torah text recitations + Aaronic blessing. Long; covers pages 5-9 of Hashkamas Ha'boker.

birchot_hashachar.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Birchos Ha'shachar
birchot_hashachar.notes: Morning blessings section. Pages 11-17 in the print siddur. Trimmed to 1951 to exclude 'Last Thoughts before Pesukei D'Zimrah' transition heading at line 1952.

akedah.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Korbanos, Akedah
akedah.notes: Feigenbaum bundles Akedah + Le'olam Yehei + Shema (first paragraph) + Atah Hu + Korbanos intro in one combined header at line 1955.

korbanot.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Korbanos
korbanot.notes: Sacrifices section. Pages 19-27 in the print siddur.

pesukei_dezimrah.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Pesukei D'Zimrah
pesukei_dezimrah.notes: Verses of praise. Long section spanning pages 29-49 in the print siddur. Includes Hodu, Mizmor LeTodah, Ashrei (first instance), Hallelu-Yah psalms, Yishtabach.

shema.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Birchos Krias Shema
shema.notes: Shema + its blessings (Yotzer Or, Ahavah Rabbah, V'ahavta, V'haya, V'yomer). Trimmed to 5894 to exclude 'OUR REQUESTS' heading (Shemoneh Esrei intro) at line 5895.

amidah.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Shemoneh Esrei
amidah.notes: Silent Amidah. Long section (pages 60-82 in print siddur) — 19 blessings + introductory/concluding paragraphs.

tachanun.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Tachanun

ashrei_uva_letziyon.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Ashrei + Uvah Letzion
ashrei_uva_letziyon.notes: Ashrei + Uvah Letzion. Feigenbaum bundles these under a 'Concluding' page.

aleinu.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Aleinu

shir_shel_yom.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Shir shel Yom
shir_shel_yom.notes: Daily Psalm. Includes seven sub-prayers (one per day of week). Pages 107+. End at 10794 (final commentary line 'happens, praise Hashem!'); excludes the post-Shacharit L'Dovid Hashem section that starts at the page header on line 10796.

pitum_haketores.ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Pitum Ha'ketores
pitum_haketores.notes: Incense recitation. Pages 113-115. Hebrew bracha text TODO (needs canonical sourcing); Feigenbaum English commentary lands now.

shesh_zechiros.notes: Six Remembrances. Page 116. Hebrew bracha text TODO (needs canonical sourcing); Feigenbaum English commentary lands now.
